verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is a payments and marketplace platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools is a category error for this kind of product. The probe showing an official Stripe MCP server is the server role, which belongs to a separate story and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
